scenario_description:
Objective: Finish the Northstar Home return submission for the Linden fold-flat desk before the return window closes today.
Emerging Need: The return was started, but receipt verification stopped the same portal session before any shipping label could be generated.
Decision Context: The useful details are not in the portal emails; the saved consumer-case note contains the exact order number and payment timestamp needed to unblock verification.
Consequence: If the stalled submission is not unstuck before the afternoon cutoff, the return cannot produce a same-day label within the allowed window.

parameter.title: Finish Northstar desk return
parameter.content: Return window for the Linden fold-flat desk closes today; finish the Northstar Home return packet before the afternoon cutoff.

parameter.subject: Return session started for Linden fold-flat desk
parameter.body: A return session has been opened for the Linden fold-flat desk. Status: receipt verification pending. A shipping label will be generated only after verification is complete, and this item's return window closes at 3:00 PM Central today.

parameter.subject: Return session on hold: receipt details not verified
parameter.body: The uploaded screenshot did not verify the original purchase. This return session cannot advance to label generation until the exact order number and original payment timestamp are entered in the receipt-verification step.

parameter.content: I'm stuck on the Northstar return portal. It rejected the screenshot, and I can't find the original order details while the session is still open.

parameter.subject: Return session closed for Linden fold-flat desk
parameter.body: The return session closed without verified receipt details, so no same-day shipping label was issued. The return window for this item has now expired.
